data.one_liner: Desktop-first widgets and themes designed for Mac and Windows
data.what_it_does: Stockholm provides a collection of desktop-first widgets and custom themes designed to look and feel great on Mac and Windows without mimicking native components too closely. It includes buttons, checkboxes, drop-downs, menus, tables, sidebars, and datetime pickers.
use_when: Building a desktop-first Flutter application targeting Mac and Windows
Creating developer tools or admin GUIs similar to Serverpod
avoid_when: Strict adherence to native OS platform styling is required
strengths: Includes custom themes and consistent styling classes
Provides common desktop components like sidebars, menus, and tables
weaknesses: No documentation available yet (example project must be used)
Limited to widgets required primarily for the Serverpod GUI
data.setup_notes: Make sure to use the provided theme classes or the UI will not look good.
